source.primary_witnesses: 11Q12 preserves sparse fragments touching Jub 6 — particularly around the calendar-polemic material (Jub 6:32-38 area is partially attested). Where 11Q12 preserves Hebrew, Hebrew is primary; otherwise Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is primary. Greek not preserved for this chapter.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII + VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; VanderKam 1998 Calendars in the DSS.
source.citation: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; VanderKam 1998 Calendars in the Dead Sea Scrolls.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 6 — **THE NOACHIC COVENANT (vv 1-22) + THE 364-DAY SOLAR CALENDAR POLEMIC (vv 23-38) — THE CENTRAL CALENDRICAL TEXT OF SECOND TEMPLE JUDAISM.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS CHAPTER — Jub 6:32-38 is THE foundational polemic against lunar-month calendar reckoning + THE foundational establishment of the 364-day solar year + THE foundational text behind the Qumran calendrical-sectarianism.** **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus`.** Also contains the BLOOD-PROHIBITION (vv 7-11, Noachic covenant Jewish-halakhic basis) + the FEAST OF WEEKS calendrical etiology (vv 17-22).

verses.text_geez: ወበቀዳማዊ፡ ለሣልስ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ታቦት፡ ወሐነጸ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-qadāmāwi la-śāləs warḫ waḍʾa ʾəm-nə tābot wa-ḥanaḍa məśwāʿa ba-wəʾtu dabr
verses.notes: **Noah exits ark on month 3 day 1 and builds an altar.** **CRITICAL CALENDRICAL DATING — MONTH 3 DAY 1 = THE BEGINNING OF FEAST OF WEEKS PREPARATION.** The Flood-exit + altar-building anchors the chapter's Feast of Weeks calendrical-etiology. cf. Gen 8:20-21.

verses.text_geez: ወአስተሳተየ፡ ምድረ፡ ወነሥአ፡ ምራረ፡ ላሕም፡ አሐደ፡ ወበግዐ፡ አሐደ፡ ወአባግዐ፡ ወሐራጊተ፡ አጋዕዝ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ናርደ፡ ወቅሌ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ምክርመም፡ ወሰናኤ፡ ወከስቦን፡ ወሥንዶል፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾastasātaya mədra wa-naśʾa mərāra lāḥm ʾaḥada wa-bagʿa ʾaḥada wa-ʾabāgʿa wa-ḥarāgita ʾagāʿz wa-qərfa nārəda wa-qəlē wa-qərfa məkrəmam wa-sanāʾē wa-kasbon wa-śəndol
verses.notes: **Noah's offering: bullock + ram + goats + sheep + various spices (nard, qele, mekremem [galbanum?], senae, kasbon, sindol).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — NOAH'S INCENSE LIST.** The aromatic-spice list parallels Adam's Eden-exit incense (Jub 3:27) and Enoch's Eden-incense (Jub 4:25) — establishing a CONTINUOUS PRE-MOSAIC INCENSE CULT FROM ADAM → ENOCH → NOAH. Cross-corpus: cf. Gen 8:20; cf. Exod 30:34 (incense recipe); cf. Test. Levi 8:1-10.

verses.text_geez: ወወደየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ሠናየ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.translit: wa-wadaya kwəlo lāʿla ʾəsāt zawəsta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-ʾaʿraga lāʿla maśwāʿta śannāya la-maʿāzā zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Pleasant aroma to the Lord.** cf. Gen 8:21 (ריח הניחוח 'sweet aroma').

verses.text_geez: ወአጠምቀ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaṭamqa ʾəgziʾ la-maʿāzā śannāy wa-ʾaqama bottu kidāna məsla Noḫ kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr
verses.notes: **The Lord smelled the pleasing aroma and established a covenant with Noah: NO MORE FLOOD.** cf. Gen 8:21-22, 9:8-11. The Noachic covenant proper begins.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ ይብዝኁ፡ ወይብዙኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይኅነጽዋ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ ለፍርሀተ፡ ወለድንጋፄ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē yəbzəḫu wa-yəbzəḫu lāʿla mədr wa-yəḫənaḍəwā wa-yəkunu la-fərhata wa-la-dəngāḍē lāʿla kwəlu zawəstatēhā
verses.notes: **Be fruitful and multiply — and be a terror to all flesh.** cf. Gen 9:1-2.

verses.text_geez: ወኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ወዘሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ ይኩንክሙ፡ ለሲሳይ፡ ከመ፡ ኀመልማለ፡ ሣዕር፡ ወሀብኩክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለበሊዕ፡
verses.translit: wa-kwəlu zayətḥawwas wa-zaḥəyāw wəʾtu yəkunəkəmu la-sisāy kama ḫamalmāla śāʿrə wahabkukəmu kwəlo la-balʿiʿ
verses.notes: **Permission to eat meat — 'as I gave the green herb' (Gen 9:3 citation).** cf. Gen 9:3.

verses.text_geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ምስለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደሙ፡ ኢትብልዑ፡ እስመ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ውስተ፡ ደሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይነቅዕ፡ ደምክሙ፡ በነፍሳቲክሙ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይነቅዕ፡ አንሰ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-bāḥtu śəgā məsla nafsu məsla damu ʾi-təbəlʿu ʾəsma nafsa kwəlu śəgā wəsta damu yəʾəti kama ʾi-yənaqqəʿ daməkəmu ba-nafəsātikəmu ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu sabʾ ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu yənaqqəʿ ʾansa nafsa sabʾ
verses.notes: **THE BLOOD-PROHIBITION + MURDER-PROHIBITION.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — NOACHIC BLOOD-LAWS**: 'do not eat flesh with its life, with its blood' (Gen 9:4) + blood-vengeance principle (Gen 9:5-6). **The blood-prohibition is the FOUNDATIONAL JEWISH NOAHIDE LAW + the FOUNDATIONAL EARLY-CHRISTIAN GENTILE-INCLUSION COMMAND** (Acts 15:20, 29 — 'abstain from blood').  **The blood = life equation** (cf. Lev 17:11) is established here universally — not just for Israel but for all humanity.

verses.text_geez: ወዘይክዕው፡ ደመ፡ ሰብእ፡ በሰብእ፡ ይክዐው፡ ደሙ፡ እስመ፡ በአርአያ፡ እግዚእ፡ ገብረ፡ ሰብአ፡
verses.translit: wa-zayəkəʿwə dama sabʾ ba-sabʾ yəkəʿaw damu ʾəsma ba-ʾarʾayā ʾəgziʾ gabra sabʾa
verses.notes: **'Whoever sheds the blood of a human, by humans his blood shall be shed, for in the image of God he made man.'** Direct citation of Gen 9:6. **Cross-corpus**: foundational Noahide law on capital punishment + imago Dei doctrine. cf. Matt 26:52.

verses.text_geez: ወአንትሙስ፡ ብዝኁ፡ ወብዝኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾantəmusə bəzəḫu wa-bəzəḫu lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **'And as for you, be fruitful and multiply on the earth.'** cf. Gen 9:7.

verses.text_geez: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡ ዘይነውዕ፡ በውስተ፡ ሥጋ፡
verses.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ wa-wəludu kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama zayənawwəʿ ba-wəsta śəgā
verses.notes: **NOAH AND HIS SONS SWORE NEVER TO EAT BLOOD.** Oath-formalization of v. 7 prohibition.

verses.text_geez: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኪዳነ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ በውእቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ ሣልስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ kidāna ba-qədmēhu ba-wəʾtu warḫ śāləs lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **Noah swore a covenant on the third month — establishing the FEAST OF WEEKS calendrically.** Bridge to vv 17-22 below.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይቤለከ፡ አኮ፡ ኪያከ፡ ባሕቲተከ፡ ከመ፡ አንበሮ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ አላ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ሤመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəbēlaka ʾakko kiyāka bāḥtitaka kama ʾanbaro kidāna məsla daqiqa Noḫ ʾallā ʾəska kwəlu təwlədə śēma lottu śərʿata kidānu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **The covenant extends to all generations of Noah's descendants — a perpetual cosmic covenant.** Bridges Noachic-covenant to Israelite-covenant.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ ግበር፡ በዕለታት፡ ኪዳነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta gəbar ba-ʿəlatāt kidāna lāʿla daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama
verses.notes: **Moses commanded to teach Israel the blood-prohibition.** Embedding Lev 17 in Noachic-covenantal continuity.

verses.text_geez: ወውእቱ፡ ዘይብላዕ፡ ደመ፡ እምነ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእምነ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእምነ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይትሰረው፡ ብእሲሁ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-wəʾtu zayəbəlāʿ dama ʾəm-nə ʾənəssā wa-ʾəm-nə ʾarāwit wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaʿwāf ba-kwəlu mawāʿəla mədr yətsaraw bəʾəsihu wa-bəʾəsitu ʾəm-nə mədr
verses.notes: **Karet penalty for blood-consumption.** cf. Lev 17:10-14.

verses.text_geez: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወለዘርዑ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ la-Noḫ wa-la-zarʿu təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **Sign given: the rainbow.** cf. Gen 9:13-16.

verses.text_geez: ቀስቶ፡ አንበረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደመና፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: qastō ʾanbara lāʿla damanā la-səmʿ lāʿla kidāna ʿālam kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr
verses.notes: **'He set his bow in the cloud as a sign of the eternal covenant.'** cf. Gen 9:13.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ወተጸሐፈ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ በዓለ፡ ሰሙናት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ አሐደ፡ ምዕር፡ በዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለትሕድሶ፡ ኪዳን፡ በኵሉ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዓመት፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza wa-taṣaḥafa lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy kama yəgbaru baʿāla samunāt ba-zəntu warḫ ʾaḥada məʿr ba-ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat la-təḥdəso kidān ba-kwəlu ʿāmat la-ʿāmat
verses.notes: **MAJOR — THE FEAST OF WEEKS = ANNUAL COVENANT-RENEWAL inscribed on the heavenly tablets.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUBILEES MAKES SHAVUOT THE COVENANT-RENEWAL FESTIVAL.** **Bidirectional with heavenly-tablets glossary entry.** **The Jubilees-distinctive identification of SHAVUOT with COVENANT-OATH** (Hebrew שבועות 'weeks' / שבועה 'oath' — bilingual pun) is one of the most distinctive Jubilees-theological-innovations. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1QS 1:16-2:18 (Qumran annual covenant-renewal ceremony at Shavuot); cf. CD 9:2-5; cf. Acts 2 (Pentecost = Shavuot = the Spirit-covenant in the early church). **The Qumran community's annual covenant-renewal at Shavuot DERIVES from this Jubilees etiology.**

verses.text_geez: ወአልቦ፡ ካልአ፡ በዓል፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘርእ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalbo kāləʾa baʿāl zayətgabbar lāʿla kwəlomu zarʾ daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām
verses.notes: **Shavuot is the ONLY festival kept FROM NOAH TO ABRAHAM.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Shavuot is the ARCHAIC PATRIARCHAL FESTIVAL.** All other festivals are later codifications. Shavuot continuous from Noah to Abraham to Sinai. This positions Shavuot as the MOST ANCIENT and FOUNDATIONAL of all festivals.

verses.text_geez: ወወድቀ፡ ዝንቱ፡ በዓል፡ በሰማይ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ፍጥረት፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ፳ ወ፮ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፭ ሰሙናት፡
verses.translit: wa-wadqa zəntu baʿāl ba-samāy ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla fəṭrat ʾəska mawāʿəla Noḫ 26 ʾiyobēləwāt wa-5 samunāt
verses.notes: **The festival was kept in HEAVEN BY THE ANGELS FROM CREATION TO NOAH** — 26 jubilees + 5 weeks of years. **MAJOR — CELESTIAL OBSERVANCE OF SHAVUOT** before Noah brings it to earth. cf. Jub 2:18 (angels of presence + angels of sanctification keep Sabbath with Israel).

verses.text_geez: ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ እስከ፡ ፯ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፩ ሰሙን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ እስከ፡ ሞተ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወእምነ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞቶ፡ ለኖኅ፡ አጥፍኡ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለነገር፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ አብርሃም፡ ወእምነ፡ ዘመነ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡ ይብልዑ፡ ደመ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaqama Noḫ wa-wəludu ʾəska 7 ʾiyobēləwāt wa-1 samun ʾiyobēləwu ʾəska mota Noḫ wa-ʾəm-nə ʿəlata moto la-Noḫ ʾaṭfəʾu daqiqu la-nagar qəddus ʾəska ʿəlata ʾAbrəhām wa-ʾəm-nə zamana Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām yəbəlʿu dama
verses.notes: **Noah's sons abandoned Shavuot after Noah's death until Abraham. From Noah to Abraham they ATE BLOOD.** **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: ABRAHAM IS THE RESTORER OF SHAVUOT (and the BLOOD-PROHIBITION) after a 7-jubilee + 1 week lapse.**

verses.text_geez: ወአብርሃም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ዐቀቦ፡ ወይስሐቅ፡ ወያዕቆብ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ዐቀብዎ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕሊከ፡ ዘአስሐትከ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾAbrəhām bāḥtitu ʿaqabō wa-Yəsḥaq wa-Yāʿqob daqiqu ʿaqabəwo ʾəska mawāʿəlika zaʾasḥatka
verses.notes: **Abraham + Isaac + Jacob kept Shavuot — until Moses' day when it was forgotten again.** Abraham as Shavuot-restorer becomes archetypal.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ ግበሮ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ደብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ለዓለም፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለልምድ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ በዐሥር፡ ወአርብዓ፡ ቦቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ ይኩንዎ፡ ቡሩከ፡ በዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta gəbaro ba-zəntu dabr śərʿata la-ʿālam la-təwlədomu la-ləməd la-la-ʿāmat ba-zəntu warḫ ba-ʿaśr wa-ʾarbəʿā bottu ʿəlatāt yəkunwo buruka ba-ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat
verses.notes: **Moses commanded to establish Shavuot on this mountain (Sinai) for all generations.** Sinai = the new Mount-of-Lubar (the post-flood Shavuot-mountain).

verses.text_geez: ወዕለታት፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ዘወርኅ፡ ዘቀዳማዊ፡ ወዘራብዕ፡ ወዘሣልስ፡ ወዘራብዕ፡ ወዘሳድስ፡ ወዘሳብዕ፡ ወዘሳምን፡ ወዘታስዕ፡ ወዘዓሥር፡ ወዘ፲ወ፩ ወዘ፲ወ፪፡ ይትጸሐፉ፡ ወይትዜከሩ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʿəlatāt qadāmāwit zawarḫ za-qadāmāwi wa-zarābəʿ wa-zaśāləs wa-zarābəʿ wa-zasādəs wa-zasābəʿ wa-zasāmən wa-zatāsəʿ wa-zaʿaśr wa-za-11 wa-za-12 yətṣaḥafu wa-yətzēkaru
verses.notes: **Listed: the FIRST DAY of months 1, 4, 7, 10 — the FOUR INTERCALARY-DAYS of the 364-day calendar.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE TEKUFOT (EQUINOX/SOLSTICE DAYS) OF THE 364-DAY CALENDAR.** **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 364-day calendar polemic glossary entry.** The 364-day calendar has 4 quarter-divisions of 91 days each = 13 weeks each. The intercalary first-of-month-1/4/7/10 = the tekufot. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 75:1-3, 82:11-20 (the four leaders of the seasons); cf. 4Q319-4Q330 Mishmarot (priestly-courses tracking the 364-day calendar). **Note: the Ge'ez text is corrupt here listing all months 1-12 rather than just 1/4/7/10 — VanderKam Hermeneia reconstructs to 1/4/7/10.**

verses.text_geez: ወአርባዕቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለመዝከር፡ ጽሑፋን፡ በውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʾəmuntu ʿəlatāt la-mazkar ṣəḥufān ba-wəsta ṣəlāta samāy
verses.notes: **FOUR INTERCALARY DAYS inscribed on HEAVENLY TABLETS.** **HEAVENLY TABLETS REFERENCE.** Bidirectional. The four quarter-days = cosmic boundary-markers.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ ለመዋዕሊሁ፡ ሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ቦአ፡ ኖኅ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ ወእምነ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ራብዕ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምውስተ፡ ታቦት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu la-mawāʿəlihu śāləs la-warḫ qadāmāwi boʾa Noḫ wəsta tābot wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu la-mawāʿəla śāləs la-warḫ rābəʿ waḍʾa ʾəm-wəsta tābot
verses.notes: **Flood-chronology mapped to the four intercalary days.** The Flood begins month 2 day 17 / ends month 3 day 1 / restarting on intercalary day. Calendrical anchoring.

verses.text_geez: ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ እሙንቱ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጊዚያተ፡ ዓመት፡ ጽሑፋን፡ ወአንበሮ፡ ለ፫ ዘመነ፡ ዓመት፡ ጽሑፋት፡ ለመዝከር፡ ግዕዘ፡ ጊዜያቲሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt ʾəmuntu mawāʿəla giziyāta ʿāmat ṣəḥufān wa-ʾanbaro la-3 zamana ʿāmat ṣəḥufāt la-mazkar gəʿza giziyātihomu
verses.notes: **The four days = days of seasons. Three divisions of the year (90+90+90 = 90 days × 4 quarters with intercalary).** Calendrical-mathematical foundation.

verses.text_geez: ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለዘርዑ፡ በዓለ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለትዝካረ፡ ንስሐ፡ ምድር፡ ወንግሥ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አይኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaqama Noḫ lāʿla ṣəlāta lottu la-zarʿu baʿāla la-la-ʿāmat la-təzkāra nəsḥā mədr wa-nəgəśə mədr ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla ʾāyəḫ
verses.notes: **Noah codifies the four annual festivals on tablets for his seed.** Continued calendrical codification.

verses.text_geez: ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ምሰለ፡ ዓመት፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዘሎንተ፡ ይትዜከሩ፡ ዘይምጽኡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕገ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt ʾəmuntu məsla ʿāmat wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt mawāʿəla zalonta yətzēkaru zayəmṣəʾu lāʿla kwəlu ḥəga mədr
verses.notes: **Four days of the seasons commemorated.** Reinforces.

verses.text_geez: ወከመ፡ ይኩኖሙ፡ ለትዝካር፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለለ፡ ጊዜ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ለ፪ ወ፮ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ወ፰ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ለ፪ ወ፬ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ወ፪ ወ፯ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡
verses.translit: wa-kama yəkunomu la-təzkār lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ʾaḥadu la-la-gizē gizēhu la-26 samun mawāʿəl wa-8 samun mawāʿəl la-24 samun mawāʿəl wa-27 samun mawāʿəl
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 6:29; VanderKam 1989) — Ge'ez numerical text uncertain
verses.notes: **Heavenly tablets / 364-day calendar arithmetic.** The exact figures in the Ge'ez here are textually corrupt; VanderKam Hermeneia reconstructs to give 13 weeks per quarter = 91 days × 4 = 364.

verses.text_geez: ወአሐዱ፡ ለለ፡ ጊዜ፡ ቅሉጥ፡ እምነ፡ ሰሙን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ሥርዕት፡ ይከውን፡ መዋዕለ፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ዘመነ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaḥadu la-la-gizē qəluṭ ʾəm-nə samun ʾiyobēləwu kwəlu ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat la-mawāʿəl śərʿət yəkawwən mawāʿəla qadāmāwit zamana la-la-ʿāmat
verses.notes: **Calendrical structure inscribed for all generations.** Continues the calendrical material.

verses.text_geez: ወአዘዘ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ዓመተ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ፫ ምእት፡ ወ፷ ወ፬ ዕለታት፡ ወይከውን፡ ዓመተ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያቴይነኒ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይትገበር፡ በመዋዕል፡ በከመ፡ ስምዕ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾazaza lomu la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama yəʿqabu ʿāmata wəsta zəntu ḫolaqomu 3 məʾət wa-60 wa-4 ʿəlatāt wa-yəkawwən ʿāmata fəṣṣuma wa-ʾalbo zayāttēynani la-mawāʿəla qadāmāwit la-mawāʿəla baʿālāt ʾəsma kwəlu yətgabbar ba-mawāʿəl ba-kama səmʿ
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 6:32; VanderKam 1989) — note: this is one of the SINGLE-MOST-CITED verses in DSS scholarship on Qumran calendars
verses.notes: **THE CENTRAL 364-DAY CALENDAR VERSE.** **'And command the sons of Israel to keep the year by this calculation: 364 days, and it will be a complete year.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE FOUNDATIONAL 364-DAY-CALENDAR STATEMENT.** **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus`.** **CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY**: cf. 1 En 72-82 (Astronomical Book — the 364-day system); cf. 4Q317 (Cryptic A — moon phases); cf. 4Q319 Otot (signs of the 364-day cycle); cf. 4Q320-4Q330 Mishmarot (priestly courses on 364-day cycle); cf. 4QMMT B 7-9 (the calendar-section); cf. 11Q5 col. 27 (David's compositions = 3600 = 364×10 — David's calendar-mathematical encoding). **The 364-day calendar = (1) divides perfectly into 52 weeks; (2) divides perfectly into 4 × 91 days = 4 × 13 weeks; (3) places every festival on the SAME WEEKDAY every year — eliminating festival-on-Sabbath conflicts. This is the foundational Qumran sectarian calendrical claim.**

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ አዝዝ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወይዕቀቡ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ፫ ምእት፡ ወ፷ ወ፬ ዕለታት፡ ወይከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ዓመተ፡ ፍጹመ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾəzəz la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl wa-yəʿqabu ʿāmata la-la-ʿāmat lāʿla zabottu ḫolaqo 3 məʾət wa-60 wa-4 ʿəlatāt wa-yəkawwən lomu ʿāmata fəṣṣuma
verses.notes: **Repetition of the 364-day formula — emphatic.** Moses commanded to teach Israel.

verses.text_geez: ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እስከ፡ ይትዐደው፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወዕለታት፡ መዋዕል፡ ወይትዐደው፡ ዓመታት፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡
verses.translit: wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəla ʾəska yətʿaddawə bottu kidāna kidāna kwənnānē wa-ʿəlatāt mawāʿəl wa-yətʿaddawə ʿāmatāt ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu wa-yətgaḥaśu ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla baʿālāt
verses.notes: **Prophetic warning: 'days will go wrong... they will transgress the covenant of judgment... they will transgress years and festivals.'** **MAJOR — THE CALENDRICAL APOSTASY PROPHECY.** Predicts the lunar-calendar adoption that the polemic targets.

verses.text_geez: ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሰንበት፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወመዋዕል፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəla ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla sanbat wa-yətgaḥaśu kwəlu śərʿata ʿāmat wa-yətgaḥaśu gizē wa-mawāʿəl wa-yətgaḥaśu kwəlu śərʿata samāy
verses.notes: **'They will transgress days from the Sabbath days... they will transgress all the order of the year.'** **MAJOR — THE SABBATH-CALENDAR PROBLEM.** The 354-day lunar year causes festivals to FLOAT relative to weekdays, sometimes falling on Sabbath. The 364-day solar year FIXES festivals on the same weekday every year. The polemic targets this.

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ አንሰ፡ ኣአምር፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ አርእየከ፡ አኮ፡ እምነ፡ ልብየ፡ እስመ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሕልቀተ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትከሠት፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma ʾansa ʾaʾammər wa-yəʾəzēni ʾarʾəyaka ʾakko ʾəm-nə ləbəya ʾəsma maṣḥaf ṣəḥuf qədmēya wa-lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ḥəlqata mawāʿəl yətkaśśat
verses.notes: **'I know — and I now show you — not from my own heart, for the book is written before me and on the heavenly tablets the division of days is shown.'** **HEAVENLY TABLETS REFERENCE — the calendar is in the heavenly tablets.** The angel-of-presence speaks. Bidirectional. **The calendar is COSMIC LAW — pre-Mosaic, pre-Israelite.**

verses.text_geez: ወይሬእዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ላዕለ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወከመ፡ ይሕልዉ፡ ሕሠር፡ መዋዕል፡ ለሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
verses.translit: wa-yərēʾəyu kwəlomu daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl lāʿla ḫolaqo warḫ wa-kama yəḥəlləwu ḥaśar mawāʿəl la-śərʿata ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat
verses.notes: **Children of Israel will RECKON BY MOON — and will MISS 10 DAYS per year.** **MAJOR — THE EXPLICIT POLEMIC AGAINST LUNAR CALENDAR.** 364 - 354 = 10 days. **The 10-day-deficit is the SIGNATURE Qumran-calendrical polemic.** cf. 1 En 75:1-2, 82:4-7.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይዐርቡ፡ ዓመታት፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕሎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወይሬእዩ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ርኵስ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወዕለተ፡ ቅዱስ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ርኵስ፡ እስመ፡ የሐልዉ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəʿarbu ʿāmatāt lāʿlēhomu wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəlomu ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu wa-yərēʾəyu mawāʿəla rəkws mawāʿəla qəddusa wa-ʿəlata qəddus mawāʿəla rəkws ʾəsma yaḥalləwu wa-yətgaḥaśu śərʿata ʿāmat
verses.notes: **'They will mix unclean days with holy and holy days with unclean — for they will err.'** **MAJOR — THE FESTIVALS-ON-WRONG-WEEKDAYS POLEMIC.** Festivals observed in error. **CROSS-CORPUS — Qumran sectarian calendrical-claim**: cf. 4QMMT B 7-9; cf. CD 3:14-15.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አዝዝ፡ አንተ፡ ወአስምዕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይትገሐሱ፡ ካዕበ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡ ምስለ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይትሰዐሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu ʾəzəz ʾanta wa-ʾasmaʿ lāʿlēhomu ʾəsma yətgaḥaśu kāʿba kāləʾa wa-kama ʾi-yətgaḥaśu kāʿba mawāʿəla baʿālāt wa-kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama məsla śəgā wa-kama ʾi-yətsaʿalu mawāʿəla ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu
verses.notes: **'Therefore command and testify against them not to transgress the festivals and not to eat blood and not to forget the times.'** **THREE-FOLD MOSAIC COMMISSION**: (1) calendar-keeping (the polemic-target), (2) blood-prohibition (Noachic continuity), (3) festival-keeping. **Closes the polemic + closes chapter.**
